title: Monopoly Champion Agent - Experiment Log Entry
description: One JSON file per meaningful training/benchmark/reproducibility/A-B/replay run. See logs/experiments/README.md for the standard. Unknown values use null, never a guess.

experiment_id.description: Zero-padded sequence number + kebab-case slug, matches the filename without .json, e.g. 001-fixed-agent-engine-smoke.

code_commit_sha.description: The clean git HEAD SHA of THIS repo at the moment the experiment was actually run (git rev-parse HEAD, captured only when git status --porcelain was empty). This is NOT the commit that later recorded/committed the results - do not backfill it with that. null only if genuinely unknown (e.g. the clean-tree-before-running discipline did not exist yet when the run happened).

reference_submodule_sha.description: Pinned references/DeepRL_Monopoly commit SHA at the time of the run.

exact_commands.description: Exact shell command(s) run, in order, including required env vars (e.g. PYTHONHASHSEED=0).

algorithm_config.description: Free-form: algorithm name, hyperparameters, opponent pool, engine ruleset id, etc. Use null for individual unknown values, not for the whole object.

counts.description: Free-form: games, rounds, decisions, positions/samples, updates, etc., whichever apply. Use null for values that don't apply to this experiment type.

metrics.description: Win/loss counts, win rates, Wilson intervals, net worth, round-cap rate, or other important result metrics. null if this experiment produced none.

loss.description: Training loss figures (e.g. loss, policy_loss, value_loss, gradient_norm). null if this experiment recorded no loss (e.g. a pure evaluation run) or the reference's own logging doesn't expose one.

result.description: One-paragraph conclusion. Must not claim improvement/strength without statistical support (see docs/EXPERIMENTS.md for the paired-eval discipline this project uses).

raw_logs.description: Repo-relative paths to raw stdout/stderr/output artifacts for this run, if any exist and are small enough to commit. null or [] if none.

notes.description: Optional free-text caveats, corrections, or context that don't fit another field.
